top.en: Your biggest mistake isn't how you play, it's that in elimination matches you simply don't have a champion to hard carry on. Last year in the Swiss stage elimination matches, Gumayusi was inting harder than Viper, but Faker pulled out a Azir and a Ryze, dying zero times to lift T1 into the Swiss stage. Last year in elimination matches you picked a Galio and got spun around like a top, then picked a Smolder and got spun around like a top—it had me in stitches. When will you ever step up when your teammates throw or are playing poorly, instead of complaining, and actually carry the game carrying your teammates' share of the weight? Then you'll be close to a championship. Some might say this is being too harsh on you, but who told you to play the main-carry mid-lane role? Faker's greatness lies right there: just like game five of the 2024 finals, even when Gumayusi's Xayah was dying left and right, it didn't affect Faker's judgment and execution one bit. You can only touch a championship once you do the exact same thing, or even better.
